projects.title: Tradewave
projects.description: A full B2B e-commerce ecosystem — mobile app for buyers & web admin panel for vendors — handling bulk orders, inventory, and real-time tracking.
projects.longDescription:
TradeWave revolutionizes B2B commerce by providing a comprehensive ecosystem for vendors and business customers.

The platform consists of two main components: a powerful Mobile App built with React Native for customers to browse catalogs, place bulk orders, and track shipments; and a sophisticated Web Admin Panel for vendors to manage inventory, analyze sales data, and process orders efficiently. It handles complex business logic like bulk pricing, minimum order quantities, and vendor-specific catalogs.
projects.impact: Streamlines B2B ordering — reducing order processing time through a unified vendor + buyer platform.

projects.title: CollaborateX
projects.description: A real-time video conferencing platform that lets distributed teams meet, present, and collaborate without friction — no downloads required.
projects.longDescription:
CollaborateX is a cutting-edge video conferencing solution designed to bridge the gap between remote teams. Built with performance and scalability in mind, it leverages WebRTC for low-latency peer-to-peer communication.

Users can create instant meeting rooms, share their screens for presentations, and communicate via real-time chat. The application features a modern, intuitive interface that makes joining calls seamless without complex software installations.
projects.impact: Enables real-time collaboration with sub-200ms latency using WebRTC peer-to-peer connections.
features: Real-time HD Video & Audio via WebRTC

architecture.stateManagement: Zustand — chosen for its minimal boilerplate and lightweight footprint over Redux. Since CollaborateX is a real-time UI-heavy app, Zustand's direct store access avoids unnecessary re-renders and keeps call state (participants, mute, stream) snappy.
architecture.backendStructure: MVC pattern with Express.js: routes → controllers → services → models. Socket.io runs on the same server instance, enabling seamless event emission from REST controllers into active WebSocket rooms.
architecture.apiDesign: RESTful endpoints handle room creation, auth, and user management. WebRTC signaling (offer/answer/ICE candidates) is routed via Socket.io events for ultra-low latency, avoiding HTTP round-trip overhead for real-time data.
architecture.authentication: JWT-based authentication with short-lived access tokens and refresh tokens stored in HTTP-only cookies. Prevents XSS attacks while maintaining seamless session continuity across page reloads.
architecture.deployment: Frontend deployed on Vercel with automatic CI/CD from the main branch. Backend hosted on Render with a health-check endpoint keeping the instance warm. MongoDB Atlas handles cloud database with connection pooling.

projects.title: Jancode
projects.description: A 3D website portfolio for a software service company.
projects.longDescription: A visually striking 3D website portfolio designed for a software service company. This project pushes the boundaries of web experiences with interactive 3D elements, creating an immersive journey for visitors exploring the company's offerings.
projects.impact: Delivers an engaging and modern user experience with interactive 3D visuals.

projects.title: TaskFlow
projects.description: A continuous learning platform for users with push notifications, custom tasks, and management by admins and users.
projects.longDescription: TaskFlow is a comprehensive continuous learning platform that empowers users to acquire new skills through customized tasks. It features a robust push notification system to keep users engaged and on track. The platform offers dedicated portals for both admins and users to seamlessly manage learning objectives and track progress.
projects.impact: Enhances user engagement and skill acquisition through targeted tasks and timely notifications.
